output.explanation: Expanded modular-core, the sole supplied diagram; none were left unchanged. The central tree now distinguishes package APIs, retained state and implementation details. Two peripherals deepen Surface session composition and terminal decoding/storage/read models. Shared packages remain peers rather than being falsely nested under their consumers. Checked the pinned checkout without modifying it. Source-based corrections include the POSIX gather/parse pipeline, public Keyboard and StreamHandler visibility, separate message/action dispatch, mouse encoding's renderer-size dependency, bindings' config-formatter dependency, the app-only search worker, and explicit RenderState.endUpdate after unlocking. Runtime/host layout ownership and caller-owned persistent VT streams are clarified.

Ghostty's surface-centered core
|
|-- Hosting boundary [A] (App and apprt are sibling modules)
|   |-- App: shared application state
|   |   |-- Public: create/destroy, tick, addSurface/deleteSurface, updateConfig
|   |   |-- Retains: runtime-surface registry, focus, SharedGridSet, optional Device
|   |   |-- Public Message/Mailbox: cross-thread requests; tick drains on app thread
|   |   `-- -> Surface.handleMessage/performBindingAction; font and renderer resources
|   `-- apprt: compile-time host contract
|       |-- Public: App/Surface aliases, Action/Target, surface.Message/Mailbox
|       |-- Implementations: GTK/none (exe), embedded (lib), browser (wasm)
|       `-- Native UI/layout belongs to runtime/host, not the core Surface
|   Source: src/App.zig:22-78,164-198,504-537,563-613; src/apprt.zig:1-54
|
|-- Surface [S]: one terminal widget, not a window/tab/split manager
|   |-- Public lifecycle, event callbacks and action/message entry points
|   |-- Composition: owns session instances, not the packages implementing them
|   `-- -> [P] IO, [T] model, [R] display, [F] fonts, [I] codecs, [C] policy, [A] host
|   Source: src/Surface.zig:1-153; expanded in surface-session
|
|-- termio [P]: transport and application-aware VT handling
|   |-- Public Termio: init/deinit, processOutput, queueMessage, resize, getProcessInfo
|   |   |-- Owns Terminal, persistent Stream(StreamHandler), Backend and Mailbox
|   |   `-- processOutput mutates [T] while holding renderer.State.mutex
|   |-- Public Exec backend
|   |   |-- Private Subprocess: PTY/command lifecycle and shell integration
|   |   `-- ReadThread: gather -> parse pipeline; Windows uses serial reads/parsing
|   |-- Public Thread/Message/Mailbox: asynchronous writes and control
|   |   `-- Internal timers: resize coalescing, selection scroll, sync-output reset
|   |-- Public StreamHandler: VT edits/replies plus application effects
|   |   `-- Retains APC/DCS, clipboard grants/transactions and optional tmux viewer
|   `-- -> [T] decoding/state; [R] lock/wakeups/mailbox; [S] host requests; [C] settings

|           src/termio/Exec.zig:1268-1305; src/termio/stream_handler.zig:19-99
|
|-- terminal [T]: protocol semantics, screen storage and read models
|   |-- Public Terminal, Stream/Parser, Screen/PageList, search, formatter, RenderState
|   `-- Semantics are independent of Surface, PTY and GPU; app search worker is optional
|   Source: src/terminal/main.zig:1-96; expanded in terminal-model
|
|-- renderer [R]: presentation package
|   |-- Public Renderer = GenericRenderer(GraphicsAPI); public Device and size types
|   |   |-- Public: updateFrame/drawFrame, setFontGrid, setScreenSize, changeConfig
|   |   |-- Retains: cells/images, shaping cache, uniforms and swap chain
|   |   `-- Private GraphicsAPI selection: Metal or OpenGL; shaders/frame export behind it
|   |-- Public State: terminal pointer, mutex, preedit, mouse and inspector data
|   |-- Public Thread/Message: wakeups, mailbox, cursor/animation timers
|   |   `-- Internal compression scheduler -> [T] performs storage compression
|   |-- Snapshot use: lockDemand -> RenderState.beginUpdate -> unlockDemand -> endUpdate
|   `-- -> [T] snapshots/images; [F] shape/rasterize; [A]/[S] presentation; [C] settings

|           src/renderer/generic.zig:1371-1567
|
|-- font [F]: shared glyph resources, not a renderer-owned package
|   |-- Public SharedGridSet.ref/deref: configuration/size-keyed, reference-counted grids
|   |-- Public SharedGrid.getIndex/renderGlyph/cellSize
|   |   |-- Retains: resolver, glyph/codepoint caches, grayscale/color atlases, RwLock

|-- input [I]: reusable vocabulary and codecs, not Surface event policy

|   |-- Public paste.encode/encodeWriter; separate isSafe/isSafeWith checks

`-- config [C]: typed policy and loading
    |-- Public Config: load/default, loadFile/loadCliArgs, finalize, clone,

Surface [S]: session composition and event policy
|
|-- Public boundary (src/Surface.zig)
|   |-- init/deinit/close, draw, handleMessage, updateConfig
|   |-- keyCallback/textCallback/preeditCallback; mouseButtonCallback/scrollCallback
|   |-- sizeCallback/focusCallback; performBindingAction/completeClipboardRequest
|   `-- Message/Mailbox alias apprt.surface types; requests route through App.Mailbox
|
|-- Retained session composition (instances of sibling packages)
|   |-- io: termio.Termio; io_thread plus OS thread
|   |   `-- -> termio owns Terminal/stream/backend; Surface queues writes and resizes
|   |-- renderer: Renderer; renderer_thread plus OS thread
|   |   `-- -> renderer handles snapshots, GPU resources and frame scheduling
|   |-- renderer_state: renderer.State
|   |   |-- terminal points to io.terminal; mutex shared by UI, parsing and rendering
|   |   `-- Retains preedit and mouse-overlay state, optional inspector pointer
|   |-- font_grid_key, font_size and metrics
|   |   `-- -> App.font_grid_set.ref/deref; renderer receives selected SharedGrid
|   `-- Lifecycle implementation
|       |-- init derives policy, wires mailboxes/state, starts renderer and IO workers
|       `-- deinit stops search, joins renderer/IO, then frees instances, grid and mutex
|   Source: src/Surface.zig:82-153,477-507,600-719,750-765,829-881
|
|-- Event policy and retained interaction state
|   |-- Public Keyboard type: sequence_set, queued writes, key-table stack, last trigger
|   |-- Private Mouse type: click/modifier state, selection gesture, scroll/link state
|   |-- Surface fields: pressed_key and last_binding_trigger
|   |-- Private maybeHandleBinding runs before private encodeKey
|   |   |-- Consumed shortcuts stop here; unconsumed events may become terminal input
|   |   `-- -> input bindings and keyboard/mouse/paste codecs; Termio.queueMessage
|   `-- -> Terminal modes, active Screen selections, text extraction and search
|   Source: src/Surface.zig:105-131,230-301,2792-2846,2987,3326-3423
|
|-- Selection, clipboard and host effects
|   |-- Selection gestures and links use terminal state, not native window layout
|   |-- Clipboard completion applies policy/permissions before input is queued
|   `-- -> apprt runtime callbacks/actions for clipboard, titles and UI requests
|   Source: src/Surface.zig:3918,4941,6017; src/apprt/surface.zig:14-95
|
|-- Optional integrations (owned instances; separate implementation packages)
|   |-- Private Search wrapper: terminal.search.Thread plus OS thread
|   |   `-- -> terminal.search matching; wrapper stops/joins the worker on teardown
|   `-- Inspector pointer -> inspector.Inspector input/PTY/render diagnostics
|   Source: src/Surface.zig:137,210-227; src/inspector/Inspector.zig:1-79
|
`-- Configuration application
    |-- Private DerivedConfig owns copied policy; conditional state retained per surface
    |-- updateConfig applies conditionals and sends derived renderer/Termio settings
    `-- -> config.Config; App.updateConfig is the distributor, not a retained Config owner
    Source: src/Surface.zig:144-153,305,1804-1888; src/App.zig:172-198

terminal [T]: renderer-independent semantics and storage
|
|-- Stream decoding (public Stream(Handler), StreamAction and Parser)
|   |-- Internal composition: Parser + UTF8Decoder + partial-sequence continuation
|   |-- Stream emits typed VT actions to its handler; preserve it across byte chunks
|   `-- TerminalStream = Stream(stream_terminal.Handler)
|       |-- Terminal.vtStream/vtHandler create caller-owned stream/handler state
|       `-- Default handler edits Terminal; optional effects callbacks provide side effects
|   Source: src/terminal/main.zig:48-64; stream.zig:1-36;
|           src/terminal/stream_terminal.zig:31-65; Terminal.zig:411-430
|
|-- Terminal (public type)
|   |-- Public: init/deinit, print/printSlice, resize, vtStream/vtHandler
|   |-- Retains modes, colors, tabstops, cursor policy, dimensions, title/pwd
|   `-- screens: ScreenSet
|       |-- Primary Screen; alternate Screen initialized lazily; tracks active/generations
|       `-- Each Screen
|           |-- Cursor/saved cursor, tracked Selection, charset and dirty flags
|           |-- Kitty keyboard stack/images, semantic-prompt state
|           `-- pages: PageList
|               |-- Ordered page nodes: scrollback through active screen
|               |-- Pages contain rows/cells and associated text/style data
|               |-- Allocation/pools, viewport and tracked Pins
|               `-- Resident/compressed storage; private Node (reachable via public List)
|   Source: src/terminal/Terminal.zig:45-143,344-428;
|           src/terminal/ScreenSet.zig:1-99; Screen.zig:37-88; PageList.zig:1-110
|
|-- Protocol vocabulary and handlers (siblings of Terminal, not host policy)
|   |-- CSI/OSC/DCS/APC, colors/modes, device reports and semantic prompts
|   |-- Kitty keyboard/graphics/clipboard protocol types
|   `-- -> Applied by terminal stream handler or application-aware termio.StreamHandler
|   Source: src/terminal/main.zig:1-86; src/terminal/stream_terminal.zig:1-41
|
|-- Public read models (consumers of screen state)
|   |-- Selection/SelectionGesture and formatter: selection tracking and text views
|   |-- search
|   |   |-- Public Active, PageList, Screen, Terminal and Viewport search types
|   |   |-- Private sliding-window machinery
|   |   `-- Thread only for Ghostty artifact; void in library build (xev dependency)
|   `-- RenderState (in terminal/render.zig, NOT renderer.State)
|       |-- Retains incremental render data, cells, selections and dirty regions
|       |-- beginUpdate reads Terminal while caller synchronizes access
|       `-- endUpdate completes using owned memory; update performs both phases
|   Source: src/terminal/main.zig:17-26,48-64; search.zig:1-22; render.zig:24-66
|
`-- Consumer boundary
    |-- termio owns the live Terminal and its own application-aware persistent stream
    |-- Surface uses modes, selections, formatter and optional search worker
    |-- renderer consumes RenderState; font shaping consumes its cells
    `-- No PTY, Surface or graphics backend required by the terminal semantics
    Source: src/termio/Termio.zig:40-67; src/font/shape.zig:71-78
